answer: When a grader gets slashed for passing a honeypot, recount every pass it cast over the last 20 epochs as if its seat had been empty. If the rest of that panel still has a pass majority, nothing changes. If not, the author keeps the pay but loses that pass toward Established. Say a farm account pushed a junk answer on opal pricing over the line 3-2, then did the same for a vague atlas of shipping routes. Once it's caught, both unwind together, and nobody has to whisper accusations since the slash triggers it. Honest passes usually rest on 4 or 5 real votes, so they hold.
